svg.title: Con Rồng cháu Tiên
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene in warm golden light: a happy little child with a black topknot and a bright red tunic stands on a green hill with both arms up, laughing. On the left the sea shines, with the jade-green dragon flying above it; on the right rise the green mountains, with a white egret flying above them, and a golden star-sun shines in the middle.
